title: ACDF Case A2: judged acceptance with a de-novo appeal that reaches no fresh decision
task: Deliver a short note stating, for the Agent Collective Decision Framework draft ERC (ERC-8436), what an appeal round that ends without a decision means under each appeal mode.
acceptance: A 3-of-5 roster of jurors votes under ACDF policy family acdf.sepolia.case-a2, version 1, appeal mode REQUIRE_FRESH_DECISION. The adapter contract is the task's acceptance authority. In this case round 1 decides Yes, the decision is appealed, and the appeal round ends without a decision: the issue ends in NoDecision and the adapter executes nothing; the tender's own judgment clock governs.
